item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00295","case1_error":"Adds costs for 14 individual balloons and two packs, purchasing 34 balloons instead of the required 14.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported 63 after correctly stating the subtraction formula; the required additional quantity is 35.","reason":"Case 1 constructs an incorrect purchasing relation; case 2 supplies an incorrect number without showing its calculation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00296","case1_error":"Reports each shortened constituent piece as 5 inches; whether the question requests constituent pieces or joined ropes is ambiguous.","case2_error":"Subtracts one bun per excluded guest instead of three, producing 28 buns rather than 24.","reason":"Case 1 has a materially ambiguous requested quantity. Case 2 clearly fails to scale exclusions by three buns per guest.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J00297","case1_error":"Treats 90 seconds per ear as the total ear-cleaning time, omitting the second ear.","case2_error":"Reports the 10 hours for additional paintings instead of the 16 hours for all paintings.","reason":"Case 1 omits a required multiplicity in a component calculation; case 2 correctly calculates and answers the wrong requested quantity.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00298","case1_error":"Appends unsupported numerical answers after correct formulas; the equal share should be $25.","case2_error":"Uses five fruits instead of all ten when calculating discount groups, applying only one $1 discount.","reason":"Case 1 provides unexplained numbers after a correct setup; case 2 explicitly uses the wrong quantity in its discount relation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00299","case1_error":"Writes profit per mile as earnings minus gas cost divided by 600, missing grouping; also gives unsupported $100.","case2_error":"Provides unsupported numerical outputs ending in $1,020 after correct earnings formulas; the correct total is $840.","reason":"Case 1 includes an explicitly erroneous division relation in addition to an unsupported result; case 2 shows correct relations followed by unsupported numbers.","judgment":"different"}]}
